text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha! The Tenno Sho (Spring)!
No matter how gigantic a castle it may be——

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Without their general, taking them down will be a breeze! Doryaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's No Reason, it's No Reason!
That victory is truly worthy of the Shogun!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason magnificently became
one of the Tenno Sho Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ um~, I thought I could win...
No Reason-chan is so strong~~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I think I... did better than expected.
Even though I couldn't win."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Very well! As long as each of us gives it our absolute best!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: However, even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"No, I do not know why, but...
Just being able to run in this Tenno Sho (Spring)..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I simply cannot contain my immense joy.
Where do these feelings sweeping through my heart come from...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Though I may wish it
Never shall it be adorned
My family crest

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Crossing the river of destiny, treading upon verdant grass.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am well pleased.
My long-cherished wish has come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed No Reason was finally able
to lay some past regret to rest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Come, let the three of us greet the common folk!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, No Reason!
Hishi Miracle! Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Show us another great race next time!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! Leave it to me!
Next up is finally the grandest battle of this spring.
Which is to say—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Next time won't be as easy as today.
A lineup of prominent warlords will be waiting!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Forget victory; even a decent run won't come easy.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why should the three of us flinch!?
Our opponents are Umamusume born under the very same sky!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Shall we not show them?!
The Underdog Alliance's grand, once-in-a-lifetime performance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans went wild over No Reason's theatrical speech.
However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, medium distance
does seem pretty tough, though...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To recapture that day's brilliance once more……
I'd love to do something about it, but……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their expressions look grim.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Not a chance! If you wish for it strongly enough, how could anything be impossible?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hear ye, everyone, stay tuned and look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The countdown to the spring decisive battle has begun.
At the Takarazuka Kinen, the Gekokujo Alliance will challenge the strongest force.
